visible_defect: Excessive dark/saturated unit-body tone; not white-return placement or missing rim illumination.
model: ONE common gain and bias across all RGB and both references. Existing neutral_color_response on retained INSIDE raw samples BEFORE AA; clear exact; original full foreground chain.
train: All original glass pixels excluding original held and both inclusive/half-open original foreground boxes. Each reference contributes one half of mean RGB squared error. No crop objective.
solve: One finite active-set least-squares proposal: three exact edge minima and unconstrained interior plus identity/vertices as needed; <=8 unique complete quadratic checks. No iterative optimization.
guards: Every original and completed paired E/glass/rim/held/interior/SSIM/exterior/glyph, plus all original38 partial-glass pixels per reference. Stop first numerical qualifier for immediate visual inspection; no dependent proposal.
diagnostics: Reuse unchanged four crop rectangles and frozen adjacent-luma RMS/difference-to-target diagnostic from blur stage; advisory only, never optimized.
accounting: Reserve two original Study mask constructions before evaluation. Existing SSIM filtering is a separately counted unchanged metric, not new material filtering. No import of baseline common.py or old ledger mutation.
stop: Identity/model representability failure; first strict pair pending visual/primary review; four predetermined factors; any cap/deadline. No extra solve or factor.
frozen: Source/case/vector/style/pose/map/index/D/AA2/seedblur/clear/masks/shadow0; historical fingerprints and ordering disclosures preserved.
adoption: No automatic component or historical pass adoption.
